question: Should Crabline intentionally stop supporting externally reachable Matrix webhooks until provider-native authentication exists, or must this PR preserve external Matrix operation through an authenticated ingress implementation?
rationale: The current patch closes an authentication exposure but also removes an existing deployment mode; repository policy and upgrade impact do not establish whether that removal is the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Keep fail-closed boundary
options.body: Explicitly approve external Matrix as unsupported for now and add operator-facing migration and limitation documentation.

options.title: Add authenticated Matrix ingress
options.body: Implement and verify the provider-native authenticated Matrix transport before enforcing the external exposure check.

options.title: Split Matrix hardening
options.body: Remove Matrix from this PR and track its authentication boundary separately while the other provider fixes proceed.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed boundary
recommendation.body: Explicitly approve external Matrix as unsupported for now and add operator-facing migration and limitation documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member owns the current cross-provider hardening work and is the best available person to route the boundary decision.
